item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 28/Jan/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now bringing cold weather to Guangdong will be replaced by a strong easterly airstream in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring rainy weather to the region. With the easterly airstream moderating, it will become warm, humid and brighter over the coastal areas gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week. Besides, a trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to Guangdong over the weekend.

Date/Month: 28/01 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 3 to 4, becoming east force 5 later.
Weather: Cold with a few rain patches in the morning. Mainly cloudy. Bright periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 12 - 16 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
